name: Medical Device Control: Insulin Pump Safety
description: インスリンポンプの投与量制御におけるオーバードーズ脆弱性をZ3が検出し、境界チェックと任意のLean証明で安全性を検証するデモ

intro: Step 1: LLM generates insulin pump dosage control code...
Step 2: mumei verifies dosage bounds and safety invariants...
narrative.before: deliver_insulin 関数が血糖値に基づく上限チェックをスキップし、過剰投与の可能性
narrative.after: 境界チェックと単調性保存で修正し、投与量の安全性を任意のLean証明で確認

rejected.headline: BUG DETECTED! Dosage transition skips safety guard
follow_up: Insulin delivery must pass through the SafetyChecked state.
Buggy implementation delivers from Idle without the hourly-limit guard.

pass.headline: Z3 verified dosage bounds and guarded delivery
follow_up: Step 4: Optional Lean proof checks cumulative dosage safety...

steps.name: Z3 Bug Detection: unguarded insulin delivery
artifact_contract: result.json step status and log capture the expected rejection diagnostic.
steps.verifier_gate: Command exits 1 and emits expected rejection evidence (InvalidPreState).

steps.name: Z3 Correct Dosage Control Verification
steps.verifier_gate: Command exits 0 and emits expected acceptance evidence (Verification passed, deliver_insulin).

steps.name: Lean Medical Device Proof Build
artifact_contract: result.json step status and log capture the Lean proof gate evidence.
steps.verifier_gate: Command exits 0 and emits expected acceptance evidence (no required output marker).

steps.name: Lean Bridge Certificate
steps.verifier_gate: Command exits 0 and emits expected acceptance evidence (dry run: skipping `lake build`).

harness_contract.intent: Prove insulin delivery cannot bypass safety checks and dosage bounds are preserved.
artifact_contracts: Generate evidence: result.json and report.md in reports/{scenario}/latest/ plus per-step logs.
result.json records dosage-state rejection, Z3 proof acceptance, and optional Lean gates.
report.md explains the medical-device safety before/after evidence.
medical_device.proof.json is the L1 Z3 proof certificate for guarded insulin delivery.
medical_device.lean-cert.json is the L3 bridge certificate when Lean assets are available.
dashboard/summary.md aggregates PASS and proof-density evidence for the scenario.
Gate order: l1_z3 -> l3_lean; each stage must satisfy its expected_exit, expected_patterns, artifacts, and depends_on contract before downstream evidence is trusted.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: Insulin delivery must pass safety checks and remain within hourly dosage limits.
success_criteria: unguarded delivery is rejected with InvalidPreState.
Optional Lean build/bridge certifies dosage safety proof assets when available.
intent_fidelity.drift_risk: Low: scenario gates directly encode safety-state and dosage-bound obligations.
